title: Does Grand Theft Auto 6 live up to the hype?
description:
GTA 6 — among the most-anticipated video games ever — is finally out. Reviews have been overwhelmingly positive, with fans and critics alike praising the life-like graphics, the catchy soundtrack and the inclusion of Lucia, the game’s first-ever female protagonist since the franchise went 3-D. Tom Richardson, our gaming reporter, shares his experience playing the game and tells us about its minor bugs and glitches. We also hear from GTA fans around the world and from DJ Lag, a South African producer whose music can be heard on AfroBank FM in the game.

Instagram: @bbcwhatintheworld Email: whatintheworld@bbc.co.uk WhatsApp: +44 330 12 33 22 6 Presenter: Hannah Gelbart Producers: Mollie Perella, William Lee Adams, Rita Behadini Editor: Verity Wilde
summaryZh: 本集 BBC 節目《What in the World》探討最新發售的熱門電玩遊戲 GTA VI 是否符合大眾的高度期待。 BBC 記者 Tom Richardson 分享遊玩體驗，提到該遊戲在 Metacritic 評分高達 99 分。遊戲擁有極致逼真的畫面與 NPC 細節，並引進 3D 系列歷史上首位女性主角 Lucia 做為重要角色。節目也訪問了在遊戲電台登場的南非製作人 DJ Lag ，並介紹 Travis Scott 與 Lana Del Rey 等巨星加盟的廣播曲目。雖然遊戲在 PS5 與 Xbox Series 基礎機型上偶有流暢度下降或操作較為笨重等小瑕疵，整體表現依然大獲讚賞。
summaryEn: This episode of What in the World explores whether the highly anticipated video game Grand Theft Auto VI lives up to the massive hype. BBC gaming reporter Tom Richardson shares his first impressions of the game, highlighting its breathtaking graphics, detailed world, and near-perfect Metacritic score of 99. The episode also highlights Lucia, the franchise's first 3D-era playable female protagonist, and discusses the game's iconic soundtrack featuring South African producer DJ Lag alongside stars like Travis Scott and Lana Del Rey. Despite minor performance frame-rate drops on older console models and slightly clunky controls, overall reception remains overwhelmingly positive.
